t: The Gold Pan: Engineering Hybrid Hierarchies with AI
s: This article details the 'Gold Pan' methodology for transforming flat website structures into AI-driven hierarchies using a 'Rule of 7' link-graph, leveraging market data for SEO optimization and resilient content management, while exploring AI collaboration challenges.
